full_judgment: Mohammad Abdur Rouf, J.: Pre-emptor respondent No.1 instituted Pre-emption Misc. Case No.10 of 1987 in the Court of Munsif (now Assistant Judge), Narsingdhi under section 24 of the Non-Agricultural Tenancy Act, 1949 in respect of .05 acre of homestead land which her co-sharer, respondent No. 2 , sold on 2-11-86 at a consideration of Tk. 6000/- to the pre-emptee-petitioner. She (pre-emptor) claimed herself as a co-sharer by inheritance in respect of relevant C.S. Khatian No. 96/1 comprising of an area of 89 decimals. She came to know about the transfer on 6-11-86 and thereafter filed the case.
